analysis.title: GS Kamshad - GS TMT TODAY 10.6.26
key_insights: Futures are higher (Nasdaq +60bps, S&P +40bps) as Nasdaq continues to break out to new all-time highs. Global bond yields are easing, with US 10Y -3bps to 5.27% and WTI -2% to $87.

GOOGL agreed a 20-year deal to buy 890 MW of new nuclear power from Constellation Energy (CEG +6%). Constellation will spend more than $4.3B on the build-out, and the capacity comes onto the PJM grid.

STX and WDC are down 2% on competition concerns. Seagate and Toshiba are reported (Bloomberg) to be bidding for TDK's magnetic-heads unit, the only independent maker of HDD recording heads. The deal could be worth several billion dollars. Toshiba's spokesperson said the article was inconsistent with its understanding.

SPCX is up 2% and breaking out to levels not seen since the early days of its IPO. GS Research published a bullish Q3'26 preview (Sheridan), raised AI segment estimates (capacity, revenue, margins) and raised the target to $230. GS sees AI segment estimates as still conservative versus the Street over the next 6-18 months absent a broader AI correction.
NVDA is approaching a $6T market cap, up 5 of the last 6 sessions since the new $150B buyback announcement, and +1% this morning.

AMD is +2% after CEO Lisa Su said chip demand will stay 'very high' for the next few years and that demand is outpacing supply even with higher output. She reiterated AMD's pledge to invest more than $10B in Taiwan.
PINS named Amazon veteran James Dibbo as CFO, starting Oct. 26.

NFLX Q3 2026 earnings preview (Sheridan): shares are down 10% since the 7/16 report versus the S&P 500 +3%. GS ties this to engagement-metric scrutiny and a debate over whether NFLX needs more capital (an IP acquisition or higher cash content spend in 2027+). GS models cash content expense growing slower than revenue and remains very positive on NFLX advertising.

TSMC (2330.TW) earnings preview: GS reiterates Buy and raises the target to NT$3,300. It forecasts 2026E/2027E USD revenue growth of 42.0%/36.9% YoY and gross margin of 67.2%/67.5%. It raises 2027E/2028E CapEx forecasts to US$85B/US$98B from US$78B/US$82B. 3Q26E revenue is expected +15.3% QoQ and 4Q26E +11.0% QoQ. The 3Q26 analyst meeting is on 15 October.

US Autos and Industrial Tech 3Q26 EPS preview: GS expects Auto results and guidance in line to below the Street on average and downgrades GNTX. Industrial Tech consensus is likely moving up, but the bar for the stocks is high. Industrial Tech stocks are up 30% YTD at the median versus Autos down 6% YTD.

Macro and politics: Marine Le Pen, leading polls ahead of next year's French election, proposed a sharp deficit reduction, which helped French yields (France 10Y -11bps to 4.74%). Bessent said the US can 'very quickly' bend the debt curve.
Middle East: reports (rtrs/bbg) say Yemen recaptured critical territory from the Houthis near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, and Saudi Arabia confirmed its East-West pipeline is flowing at 5.8 mbd.
Street actions: SWKS upgraded to Buy by B Riley, and LSCC initiated at Outperform by William Blair.

sector_views.rationale: GS sees a good fundamental environment from datacenter capex, a cyclical recovery in core industrials, and secular growth in energy and robotics, though the bar for the stocks is high.
GS expects a muted cyclical backdrop and is more selective with the stocks.

earnings_insights: TSMC: GS forecasts 3Q26E revenue +15.3% QoQ and 4Q26E +11.0% QoQ (USD terms). 3Q26E gross margin is 67.5% and 4Q26E 67.3%, versus 67.7% reported in 2Q26. The 3Q26 analyst meeting is on 15 October.
NFLX: the last earnings report was 7/16, and the Q3 2026 report is upcoming. Shares are down 10% since 7/16. GS models cash content expense growing slower than revenue.
SPCX: Q3 2026 earnings are upcoming. GS raised its AI segment forecasts and target ($230).
US Autos and Industrial Tech 3Q26 previews: GS expects Auto results and guidance in line to below the Street. Industrial Tech consensus estimates are likely moving up.
Calendar: PENG reports post-market 10/6, RPM and LW pre-market and STZ post-market today, Tata Consultancy Services pre-market 10/8, DAL pre-market 10/9. TSM monthly sales are released 10/8.

tension_points.bull_case: Hit new TV series or movies could reverse the stock quickly, GS models cash content expense growing slower than revenue, and advertising revenue is gaining momentum.
tension_points.bear_case: Platform engagement trends anchor a narrative that NFLX has lost mind share, third-party data is mixed, and investors worry more capital (IP acquisition or higher content spend in 2027+) is needed.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A hit series or movie in key developed markets would reverse the stock performance in short order.

tension_points.bear_case: The bar for the stocks to trade higher is high, as in 2Q reports.
